# laravelforge_daemon (Resource)

Manages a daemon (background process) on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command the daemon runs. Changing it recreates the daemon.
- `directory` (String) Working directory the command runs in. Changing it recreates the daemon.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to create the daemon on.
- `user` (String) User account the command runs under. Changing it recreates the daemon.

### Optional

- `processes` (Number) Number of processes to run.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the daemon.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
